responsibility: Declares the PowerPC 476-specific target option table entries used by the rs6000 backend. Its central responsibility is exposing -mpreserve-link-stack, which controls the rs6000_link_stack variable saved in target options and is later consulted by 476-specific hooks to preserve the processor link stack around GOT access sequences.
same_name_distinction: Unlike 476.h and 476.md, this file is only the option-table piece of the 476 group: it declares the -mpreserve-link-stack switch and saved variable that the header’s hook overrides later consult, rather than defining hooks or scheduler automata.
